title: Save button for the allotment ledger (test fixture)
question: Which button style should the ledger use for its main action?

recommended.reason: a filled button is the only one of the three that reads as the main action next to a text field.

options.name: Solid, squared
options.note: Filled with the accent colour and barely rounded; the heaviest of the three.

options.name: Outline
options.note: A two pixel accent outline with no fill; lighter, and easier to miss.

options.name: Soft, rounded
options.note: A pale surface with dark text and round corners; reads as a secondary action.
